items.title: Deforming a triple so that the divisor is cut out by one global function, with finite type flat relative dimension one maps and injective pullback on Chow groups
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma deforms a triple to one where the divisor is the zero scheme of a single global function, with the two maps of finite type and flat of relative dimension one, injective pullback on Chow groups and the compatibility $p^*i^* = (i')^*g^*$, all of this stable under locally of finite type base change (statement lines 5939-5961). The proof is an assembly: it applies the decomposition of the section of the tensor product, takes the first component as the new divisor, and collects the four properties from that lemma, its formulae and the injectivity result. The setup of the deformation and the reading off of the listed properties are the substance, so the claim is H2.
